Ludo King Rules & Guide

1️⃣ Unlocking Pawns (Roll a 6)

Pawns start locked inside your home base. You must roll a 6 to bring a pawn out onto your color's starting square.

2️⃣ Bonus Turns

  • Rolling a 6 earns you an immediate bonus roll!
  • Rule of 3: Rolling 3 consecutive 6s cancels your 3rd roll and passes the turn.
  • Capturing an opponent's pawn awards a bonus turn!
  • Moving a pawn into the Home Triangle awards a bonus turn!

3️⃣ Safe Squares (⭐ Stars & Arrows)

Squares marked with a ⭐ Star and your starting arrow are Safe Zones. Pawns on safe squares can never be captured!

4️⃣ Capturing Opponents

Landing on an opponent's pawn on a non-safe square knocks it out and sends it back to their base, granting you an extra turn!

5️⃣ Winning the Game

Navigate all 4 of your pawns (or 2 in Quick Mode) clockwise around the board and into your Home column. The first player to get all required pawns home is crowned the LUDO KING!
